description: Marco de Referencia Geodésico 2004 is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. Este conjunto de datos presenta el Shapefile de puntos correspondientes al marco de referencia geodésico de Montevideo (MRGMVD). Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Geodesia, Geodesia de Montevideo, Harvest, Marco de referencia. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-08-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
